question: How are yoga stages connected to wonder?
premises: Wonder arises in seeing extraordinary objects.
The great yogi's wonder occurs in object-awareness enjoyments.
Those wonder-stages indicate ascent and rest in yoga.
inference: Yoga stages are wonder-filled recognitions of supreme reality, not mere cakra experiences.
uncertainties: Some compounds are densely fused and glossed as units.
The exact syntactic role of smerasmereti is unclear.
plain_english: Just as wonder arises when someone sees an extraordinary object, so the great yogi constantly experiences wonder in the appearances and enjoyments of objects, in tasting this form, and in resting from common self-sense. From absorption in ever-new wonder, the whole sense-wheel becomes smiling, contracted, and expanded. That wonder in unbounded bliss, repeated in the self without satisfaction, constitutes the stages of yoga connected to unity with supreme reality. These stages indicate ascent and rest; they are not merely experiences of root-support, point, and similar centers.
